description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Linux System Administrator to join our dynamic IT team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of Linux servers, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, ︁︀︂︃︃︁︂︇︁︂︈and implement corrective measures
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable Linux infrastructure
  • Deploy and configure virtualization solutions (e.g., XCP-ng, KVM)
  • Deploy, configure and manage various solutions based on (Nginx, HA-Proxy, Keepalived, GlusterFS, ElasticSearch, GrayLog, PostgreSQL, Redis)
  • Implement and enforce security best practices to protect systems from vulnerabilities and threats
  • Backup and recovery procedures
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to Linux systems and infrastructure
  • Participate in IT projects, contributing expertise and technical guidance
  • Assist in the planning, implementation, and testing of new systems and upgrades
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps



Nice to have:

  • Knowledge ︊︍︎︂️︃︌︈︂︆︄︅︁︁︎︌︈︂︇︍︈︆︅️︊︄︈︌︊︎︂︎of monitoring tools (ELK stack, CheckMK, Nagios, etc.)
  • Understanding of application code release management and automation
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and concepts
  • Running Docker and Kubernetes in production
  • Knowledge of Azure environments
  • Ability to work independently on the task at hand



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Chance to work with the latest technologies and tools


If you are a dedicated Linux System Administrator looking to advance your career in a supportive and challenging environment, we would love to hear from you.
Join us and be part of a team that values expertise, creativity, and teamwork.
